name: alphaportal-mcp
description: AlphaPortal school-bus transportation for Claude — students, stops, live bus location, and arrival notifications via natural language

alphaportal_refresh_token.title: AlphaPortal Refresh Token (optional)
alphaportal_refresh_token.description: Optional. If left blank, the server reads it from a signed-in AlphaPortal tab via the Transporter (fetchproxy) extension. To set it manually, in that tab's DevTools console run: JSON.parse(localStorage.user).User.RefreshToken

tools.name: alphaportal_list_students
tools.description: List the children on the account with grade, school, and transportation flags

tools.name: alphaportal_get_student
tools.description: Get a student's school plus morning and afternoon stops

tools.name: alphaportal_get_student_stops
tools.description: Get a student's assigned bus stops with times and locations

tools.name: alphaportal_get_bus_location
tools.description: Get the live GPS location of a student's bus for the AM or PM run

tools.name: alphaportal_get_report_link
tools.description: Get a PDF download link for a student's transportation report

tools.name: alphaportal_get_account
tools.description: Get the district account info and current server date

tools.name: alphaportal_list_schools
tools.description: List all schools in the district with coordinates

tools.name: alphaportal_list_requests
tools.description: List submitted transportation requests with tracking numbers

tools.name: alphaportal_session_status
tools.description: Check whether a working AlphaPortal session is configured
